components.name: Pattern
components.description: Pattern — decorative 320 × 320 tile for empty states, promo sheets, onboarding and card backgrounds. Types: Dots (16 grid), Grid (32 lines), Diagonal (20 stripes), Logo petals (brand mark, staggered 48). Tones: Subtle = fill/soft-pressed on bg/base; Accent = fill/on-color-hover on accent/default. Place behind content, never behind body text; scale the tile, do not recolour.

2.5 Pattern
Decorative 320 × 320 tiles for empty states, promo sheets, onboarding and card backgrounds. 8 variants · Type × Tone.
Overview
A pattern adds texture behind content without competing with it. One pattern per screen, always under the content layer.

Empty states and light backgrounds.
